Audience: first-time Minnesota Class D applicants, including teens on a permit or provisional license who face the stricter phone rule.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the following and low beam distances [A02], the freeway emergency rules [A05] and the phone, load and trailer rules [A07] are frequent written test items.
Level: moderate; strategy items such as SIPDE are conceptual, while headlight, flare, load and trailer rules are look-alike numbers.
Prerequisites: the speed, lane and passing rules in the traffic laws chapter and the emergency vehicle rules in the sharing the road chapter.
